ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Recall uses the camera so you can take photos to attach in chat and scan math problems from your notes or worksheets.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Recall uses the microphone so you can dictate messages and talk with Recall in Live Talk.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Recall needs access to your photos so you can attach images in chat.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Recall saves generated and chat images to your photo library when you tap Download.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Recall uses your location for local time and to answer where you are.
